title: Kid Valley Campground

services.name: Campground features
services.desc: Our small family-owned campground has forested sites surrounding a large grassy play area. We have a bathhouse with hot showers and a covered picnic area. All sites are back-in and if you have an extra large RV, please call ahead so we can save the biggest site for you. Most sites are shaded, so expect trees. Most

blurb: Set in a quiet forest, in an old homestead, the park offers a convenient base for sightseeing, hiking and biking the Mt. St. Helens area.
